name: AR_UPD_CONTACTS
description: AR_UPD_CONTACTS contains customer contact interface data entered into a simplified customer spreadsheet template for upload.

columns.name: PERSON_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identifier of the contact person.

columns.name: SALUTARY_INTRODUCTION
columns.description: Salutary name of the contact person. Value is validated against the CONTACT_TITLE lookup.

columns.name: PERSON_FIRST_NAME
columns.description: First name of the contact person.

columns.name: PERSON_MIDDLE_NAME
columns.description: Middle name of the contact person.

columns.name: PERSON_LAST_NAME
columns.description: Last or surname of the contact person.

columns.name: PERSON_LAST_NAME_PREFIX
columns.description: Last or surname prefix for the contact person, such as De or Von.

columns.name: PERSON_NAME_SUFFIX
columns.description: Last or surname suffix for the contact person, such as Jr or III.

columns.name: PERSON_PREVIOUS_LAST_NAME
columns.description: Previous last or surname of the contact person.

columns.name: PERSON_ACADEMIC_TITLE
columns.description: Academic title of the contact person, such as Dr.

columns.name: PERSON_TITLE
columns.description: Professional or family title of the contact person, such as Don, The Right Honorable, Sir, or Dame.

columns.name: PERSON_INITIALS
columns.description: Initials of the name of the contact person.

columns.name: PRIMARY_CONTACT_INDICATOR
columns.description: Indicates whether this is the primary contact person for this account or account site. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: DEPARTMENT
columns.description: Name of the department for which the contact person works.

columns.name: JOB_TITLE
columns.description: Job title of the contact person.

columns.name: RESPONSIBILITY_TYPE
columns.description: Responsibility type of the contact person, based on the CONTACT_ROLE_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: PRIMARY_RESP_INDICATOR
columns.description: Indicates whether this is the primary role responsibility of the contact person for this account or account site. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: International country code of the contact person phone number.

columns.name: PHONE_AREA_CODE
columns.description: Area code of the contact person phone number.

columns.name: PHONE_NUMBER
columns.description: Phone number for a contact person.

columns.name: PHONE_EXTENSION
columns.description: Extension of the phone number of the contact person.

columns.name: PHONE_LINE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of phone line of the phone number of the contact person, such as general, mobile, voice mail, fax, inbound, or outbound. Validated against the PHONE_LINE_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: PRIMARY_PHONE_INDICATOR
columns.description: Indicates whether this is the primary phone for the contact person. Valid values are Y or N. Either the Primary Phone Indicator or the Primary Mobile Phone Indicator can have the value Y, but not both.

columns.name: PHONE_PURPOSE
columns.description: Type of phone purpose of the phone number of the contact person, such as business or personal. Validated against the CONTACT_POINT_PURPOSE lookup.

columns.name: UNFORMATTED_PH_NUMBER
columns.description: Unformatted telephone number of the contact person. If the value of the CONTACT_POINT_TYPE lookup is PHONE, then either the Phone Number or the Unformatted Phone Number must have a valid value, but not both.

columns.name: PHONE_TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.description: Code identifying the time zone of the phone number of the contact person.

columns.name: MOBILE_PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: International country code of the contact person mobile phone number.

columns.name: MOBILE_PHONE_AREA_CODE
columns.description: Area code of the contact person mobile phone number.

columns.name: MOBILE_PHONE_NUMBER
columns.description: Contact person mobile phone number.

columns.name: PRIMARY_MOBILE_PHONE_IND
columns.description: Indicates whether this is the primary mobile phone for the contact person. Valid values are Y or N. Either the Primary Phone Indicator or the Primary Mobile Phone Indicator can have the value Y, but not both.

columns.name: MOBILE_PHONE_PURPOSE
columns.description: Type of phone purpose of the mobile phone number of the contact person, such as business or personal. Validated against the CONTACT_POINT_PURPOSE lookup.

columns.name: UNFORMATTED_MOB_PH_NUM
columns.description: Unformatted mobile phone number of the contact person. If the value of the CONTACT_POINT_TYPE lookup is PHONE and the value of the PHONE_LINE_TYPE lookup is MOBILE, then the Mobile Phone Number or the Unformatted Mobile Phone Number must have a valid value, but not both.

columns.name: MOBILE_PHONE_TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.description: Code identifying the time zone of the mobile phone number of the contact person.

columns.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: E-mail address for the contact person.

columns.name: PRIMARY_EMAIL_INDICATOR
columns.description: Indicates whether this is the primary e-mail address for the contact person.

columns.name: EMAIL_PURPOSE
columns.description: E-mail purpose, such as business or personal. Validated against the CONTACT_POINT_PURPOSE lookup.

columns.name: INSTANT_MESSAGING_ADDRESS
columns.description: Social network instant message address of the contact person.

columns.name: INSTANT_MESSENGER_TYPE
columns.description: Name of the social network of the instant message address of the contact person, such as Facebook or Google+.

columns.name: PRIMARY_SN_INDICATOR
columns.description: Indicates whether this is the primary social network instant message address of the contact person. Valid values are Y or N.

columns.name: SOCIAL_NETWORK_PURPOSE
columns.description: Purpose of the social network instant message address of the contact person, such as business or personal. Validated against the CONTACT_POINT_PURPOSE lookup.

columns.name: WEB_URL
columns.description: Uniform resource locator of the web site of the contact person.

columns.name: PRIMARY_URL_INDICATOR
columns.description: Indicates whehter this is the primary web site of the contact person.

columns.name: WEB_URL_PURPOSE
columns.description: Purpose of the web site of the contact person, such as business or personal. Validated against the CONTACT_POINT_PURPOSE lookup.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: UPLOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the parent job that processes this record.

columns.name: UPLOAD_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates the upload status of this record.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is used by the import wizard to relate a record in the interface table to the file row.
